subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft + reforecast — Omega Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@omegahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft & next steps from today’s discovery

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Really appreciated the clarity on ingestion cadence and the compliance constraints around PHI. Per our call, I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with proposed milestones, owners, and a target close date. High level:

- Milestone 1 (POC kickoff): Redwood + Omega engineers to align on data schema and test dataset — target: 2026-05-24 — owner: Omega Data Team
- Milestone 2 (Security & Compliance review): SOC 2 evidence + network diagram reviewed — target: 2026-06-04 — owner: Omega InfoSec / Redwood security
- Milestone 3 (Pilot run): Non-PHI pilot on dedicated capacity — target: 2026-06-18 — owner: Redwood SE (Ben) / Omega Eng
- Milestone 4 (Contract & procurement): Final SOW and PO submitted — target close: 2026-06-30 — owner: Omega procurement / Marissa

Dependencies called out in the MAP: access to sanitized sample data, SOC 2 attestation, and procurement lead time (typically 2–3 weeks).

Can you confirm owners and whether the initial target close (2026-06-30) looks OK, or if you’d like us to reforecast? If helpful, Ben is available next week to review the technical checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: OmegaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@omegahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@omegahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps from today’s discovery

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with our internal view. A couple of notes from our side:

- The Data Team can commit to providing a sanitized sample by 2026-05-21 (so the POC kickoff date is fine).
- Procurement is stretched this quarter; current expectation is a 4–5 week cycle for PO approval, not the 2–3 weeks you listed. That likely pushes our target close.
- InfoSec wants to run a short questionnaire first; can Ben send over the security checklist items?

I’ll loop Procurement if you want them in the MAP; otherwise we’ll treat procurement as a dependency. For now, please revise the MAP with a reforecasted close date and an optional accelerated path if procurement completes sooner.

—Jordan
Director of Product Ops | Omega Health
jordan.matthews@omegahealth.com

Ben / Lauren —

Jordan pushed procurement to 4–5 weeks which will likely move the close out to end of July. Can Ben please prepare the security checklist for Jordan’s InfoSec and propose two updated MAP scenarios:

A) Baseline (procurement 4–5 weeks): target close 2026-07-28, milestones shifted accordingly.
B) Accelerated (procurement completes in 2 weeks): keep target close 2026-06-30 but mark procurement as expedited and add weekly checkpoints.

Also add a row flagging the need for a temporary non-PHI pilot option so we can make progress while procurement completes. I’m going to update the MAP and send v2 to Jordan.

Thanks —
Marissa

Jordan / team —

Attached is the security checklist and a short tech notes doc. Key items InfoSec asked for: network diagram, encryption-at-rest/on-transit details, data residency options, and our SOC 2 report (I attached the SOC 2 summary). I’ve also created two MAP scenarios inline in the sheet:

- Scenario A (Baseline): procurement 4–5 weeks -> target close 2026-07-28.
- Scenario B (Accelerated): procurement 2 weeks -> target close 2026-06-30 with weekly checkpoints and a dedicated procurement touchpoint.

We recommend starting the non-PHI pilot on hosted dedicated capacity the week of 2026-06-01 so you can validate throughput and latency without waiting on procurement.

Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.com

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the fast turn. The Plan looks reasonable. Procurement confirmed the 4–5 week timeline so we’ll plan for Scenario A (target close 2026-07-28).

A couple of follow-ups:
- Please keep the non-PHI pilot option as a priority so we can start early. We’ll aim to get the sanitized sample to you by 2026-05-21.
- Can you add a row for "Legal review (SLA & DPA)" with owner: Omega Legal + Redwood Legal and an estimated review window of 10 business days? That’s often where we see extra time.

If you can update the MAP with these items, we’ll circulate internally and confirm owners.

—Jordan
